# pcd_identity_user (Data Source)

Look up a user in PCD's Keystone identity service by name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Restrict the lookup to (and report) this domain.
- `name` (String) Look up the user by name.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `user_id` (String) Look up the user by ID (takes precedence over name).

### Read-Only

- `default_project_id` (String) The user's default project ID.
- `description` (String) The user description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled.
- `id` (String) The user ID.
